source.test: A. prog/hr-tempo-block@2: every literal the evaluator read shows its number in the description

ret: 3 training days (T, E and L) holding 3 exercises, over block weeks train ×3, deload, repeating.
Block weeks: train, train, train, deload, repeating. If you miss a session the plan waits: the next session is still the one you missed.
Rotation: Each training week: Day T, then Day E, then Day E, then Day L.

Attendance: Train at least 4 times in each 7-day window (from your start day); leave at least 2 days between hard sessions. If you don't train for 21 days, attendance stops counting until your next session.

tempo: A tempo run on Road Run: easy warm-up, then a tempo block at no slower than 4:45 per km with heart rate held at 85–89% of threshold, growing by 5 min each time you hold it without a very hard Borg rating, up to 40 min.
easy: 45 min easy on Road Run, heart rate under 75% of threshold.
long: 80 min easy on Road Run, heart rate under 75% of threshold.

A tempo run on Road Run: easy warm-up, then a tempo block at no slower than 4:45 per km with heart rate held at 85–89% of threshold, growing by 5 min each time you hold it without a very hard Borg rating, up to 40 min

Reads your lactate-threshold heart rate (kept on file; ignored once older than 84 days); your average heart rate (recorded during the session, avgHr); your Borg rating of the session (rated after the session).
Starts with tempo block = 20 min; written by session, owner.

Plan: Road Run: warm-up 15 min, keeping heart rate at most 80% of your lactate-threshold heart rate; your tempo block, pace at most 4:45 per km, keeping heart rate 85–89% of your lactate-threshold heart rate; recovery 10 min.

After each session:
    - if every set of “tempo” reached its target:
      - if your Borg rating of the session is below borg 17 (yes if unknown): Set tempo block to (your tempo block plus 5 min), capped at 40 min.
      - otherwise: Leave everything as is.
    - if a set of “tempo” fell short: Leave everything as is.
    - if nothing fell short but something went unlogged: Leave everything as is.
